title: Intel Form 8-K reporting August 2026 common-stock offering
excerpt: Intel sold 210,526,315 shares at $95 and the underwriters exercised their option for 31,578,947 additional shares; both closings occurred in August 2026.
summary: The offering raised $20 billion before the additional option and approximately $19.7 billion net before that option, materially strengthening liquidity while diluting the June 27 share count by about 4.8% and funding capital expenditure and working capital rather than validating external foundry economics.
